props.name: Silver Lantern Tavern
props.description: Tessa Bell welcomes travellers to the Silver Lantern. A notice board asks after a missing ledger.

props.name: Vane Forge
props.description: The forge hammers echo beneath the cobbles. A rack lies empty where the master tool-roll should be.

props.name: Temple of the Lantern
props.description: Sister Vale tends a small shrine filled with votive glass.

props.name: Training Court
props.description: Captain Brann drills novices among painted targets.

props.name: School of Glass
props.description: Pell Glass teaches the precise art of wizardry.

props.name: Tide Shrine
props.description: Nera Salt listens to echoes trapped in bottles along the tide shrine.

props.name: Briar Hearth
props.description: Aunt Vell reads the smoke of her green hearth.

props.name: Cistern Office
props.description: Iona Reed keeps the brass waterworks ledger. The pages mention a regulator and a bell beneath the village.

props.name: Old Foundry Walk
props.description: The old pipes were built into the town before anyone remembers. Their bronze lining rings at dusk.

props.name: River Steps
props.description: A dry river channel falls toward the cistern. Three scratches on the coping resemble musical notation.

props.name: South Gate Notice
props.description: An ordinance warns visitors not to open the lower valves without the cistern keeper.

props.name: Clock Arch
props.description: The village clock is four minutes slow; its gears turn when the unseen bell sounds.

props.name: Market Stalls
props.description: The traders have shutters of blue-painted wood. A quiet market lies underneath the bell tower shadow.

props.name: Firstlight Well
props.description: The well reflects a starless sky. The stonework carries a brass maker’s mark from the old cistern.

props.name: Cistern Stair
props.description: A stair behind the north gate descends to the old pumping galleries.

props.name: Lantern Alley
props.description: Lantern oil mingles with an unfamiliar floral scent near the wizard and priest guilds.

props.name: Survey Marker
props.description: A weathered marker reads: water to the south, echoes to the north.
